relations: If the press descends, the pointed die applies compressive force directly to the anvil's top surface.
The anvil rests on a striped cylindrical base, which supports its weight against the downward pressure.
As the die pushes downward, the anvil may deform or fracture depending on the applied force.
The vertical alignment of the die and anvil suggests a direct transfer of force along their central axis.
